Warehouse Associate – $19.50/hr – Weekly Pay!
Parcelway Fulfillment · Columbus, OH

Now hiring for all shifts! No experience necessary – we provide paid training.

As a Warehouse Associate you will pick, pack and ship customer orders using RF scanners, load and unload trucks, and keep your work area safe and clean.

What you need:
- Must be 18 years or older
- Able to lift up to 50 lbs repeatedly and stand for 10-hour shifts
- Must pass a background check and drug screen
- No high school diploma required
- Forklift certification is a plus (we can certify you)

What you get:
- $19.50/hr, +$2/hr on nights, weekly pay
- Overtime available
- Benefits from day one, PTO, employee discount

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
Apply in 5 minutes at the link below or text JOBS to 555-0177.
